lines.text: Many learners say: I can't concentrate in my work.
Better: I can't concentrate on my work.
Concentrate on means give all your attention to.
On! Please concentrate on the lesson.

data.wrong: I can't concentrate in my work.
data.right: I can't concentrate on my work.
data.why: Concentrate on means give all your attention to.
